findings.description: The Lambda function's environment block embeds a literal AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. These values are stored in Terraform state and are readable by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, leading to credential compromise of the underlying account.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, so known runtime vulnerabilities remain unpatched in production execution.
